required_case_inventory.geometry_frame_64: established 64 cases per boundary and caller; pure <=1e-9, ROS <=1e-6, identity/ns exact
required_case_inventory.deep_place_16: 2 yaw x 2 scene x {deep free, deep blocked, cannot-retreat, unknown}
required_case_inventory.yaw_ik_8_classes: 0->0, 0->90, 90->0, near-square, eccentric attachment, q/-q + pi/-pi equivalence, multi IK family, no-transition-region; positive+negative each
required_case_inventory.target_matrix_8: centered/eccentric/relative-yaw/tilt x sim/deploy; independent expectation error <=1e-9 (C0 fixtures in st09_contracts/fixtures.py)
required_case_inventory.attachment_negatives_9: missing, NaN, non-positive dimensions, illegal quaternion, expired, wrong frame, wrong request, re-attach, GT-as-measured; named rejection, zero business effect
required_case_inventory.map_cases_6_x2: unrelated update / related update / fully blocked / in-flight conflict / stale / restart, sim+deploy
required_case_inventory.startup_3_x2: sim+deploy x3 healthy, <=180 s READY, <=90 s teardown, mock hardware
required_case_inventory.common_negatives_per_profile: unknown schema, conflicting datum, mixed types, missing peer, stale atlas, missing URDF, duplicate provider, wrong overlay, restart
required_case_inventory.mutations: wrong-frame, position-only rotation, dropped velocities/times, legacy bypass, QP activation
required_case_inventory.performance: healthy saved graph fixture x10 warm + 1 cold, each <=10 s or named budget failure; p50/max + MoveIt call counts recorded
required_case_inventory.capture_replay: pre=ceil(2*max upstream latency), post=ceil(max downstream latency), every required chain >=1 positive sample; domain-42 three pairs off/on, median degradation <=10%
required_case_inventory.budgets: lossless replay <=1 GiB/live run, <=4 GiB campaign total; shortfall blocks new runs, never deletes failure evidence
